columns.date: Calendar month labelled YYYY-MM-01; IADB month-end dates label monthly averages, not end-month policy readings

fetch_note: Fetch BoE IUMABEDR and ONS D7G7 separately with the same retry policy. Join calendar months from 2000 onwards over the common coverage, without filling or interpolating. Only a successful complete join is live_ons; otherwise the whole dataset is illustrative.
